This analysis measures complete-item revenue (`SUM(sale_price)`) and item count (`COUNT(*)`) at the item grain. The population is filtered to items where `status = 'Complete'`. The scope is restricted to executor-authorized products. No date filter was applied in [q1]; historical coverage was not audited.

### Limitations
* This analysis did not measure distinct order volume or distinct customer counts.
* Profitability and historical discounts were not measured, as catalogue cost and retail price comparisons were not included.
